gold: Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

selector.why: The evidence of a large, firm, tender mass located near the umbilicus, serial lactate measurements between 4.7-7.2 mmol/L, and CT Abdomen findings of diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature, with no findings against it, decided the diagnosis.
